findings.title: [P1] Preserve tenant scoping in document lookups
findings.body: When tenants share the database, supplying another tenant’s document ID now queries only by `documentId`. Since `getDocument` still receives `ctx.tenantId` but no longer includes it in the lookup, this can expose another tenant’s document. Retain `tenantId` in the query predicate.

findings.title: [P1] Preserve tenant scoping in document lookups
findings.body:
In a shared database, a request can retrieve another tenant’s document by supplying its ID because the query no longer includes `ctx.tenantId`. This breaks tenant isolation and can expose cross-tenant data.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P2] Restore the exported cache module
findings.body:
Deleting `src/cache.ts` breaks compilation for any existing consumer or test importing `readCached` from this established module (`TS2307: Cannot find module`). No replacement or compatibility export is provided.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping in document lookups
findings.body:
In a shared multi-tenant database, an authenticated tenant can request another tenant’s known document ID. The query now filters only by `documentId`, so it may return that tenant’s document instead of enforcing `ctx.tenantId`, causing cross-tenant data disclosure.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
